The rules are over in the first thread, but the long and short of it is that you pick four heroes, build them into a sort of super-hero (pun intended, and revelled in) and then pit them against the newest monstrosity from the villain corner. posts.name: BlueHairedMeerkat
posts.cooked:
And thusly it began!

 

Round One

The Dreamer - Friendship is Magic

The Dreamer - 6

In Play:  Whipacorn - 7, Dark Hero - 5, Macabre Spectre - 3, Granite Oni - 6, Dark Hero - 5

Trash:

--------------------------------------------------------

Start of Turn: 

Play a Card: Macabre Spectre.

End of Turn: Whipacorn deals 5 melee damage to The Naturalist [25]. The Naturalist cannot deal damage.

Macabre Spectre deals 4 psychic damage to each non-villain target.

Granite Oni deals 4 melee damage to The Naturalist [17].

Macabre Spectre deals 4 psychic damage to each non-villain target.

-------------------------------------------------------

In Play: Whipacorn - 7, Dark Hero - 5, Macabre Spectre - 3, Granite Oni - 6, Dark Hero - 5, Macabre Spectre - 3

Trash:

Effects: ST: No Projections in play? Destroy 5 hero ongoings and flip!

ET: Whipacorn deals 3 melee damage to the highest-HP hero. A target dealt damage this way cannot deal damage until the start of the next villain turn.

ET: Macabre Spectre deals each non-villain target 2 psychic damage. (x2)

ET: Granite Oni deals the non-villain target with the lowest HP 2 melee damage.

Environment damage dealt to the Dreamer may be redirected to the lowest-HP hero.

Increase damage dealt by villain targets by 2.

Reduce damage dealt to Projections by 2. Reduce damage dealt to Granite Oni by 3.

Whenever a target is destroyed, restore Macabre Spectre to its maximum HP.

Hero HP Naturalist - 13, Expatriette - 21, Tachyon - 20, Tempest - 18, Omnitron-X - 13

 

Two comments:

1) There are enough Projections in this deck for you to win. Just. Since we're going to be playing in The Final Wasteland, be very careful... 

2) Also note that this is not a Suicidal Dreamer deck; that would just be cruel.
